title: WORLD NAME TAGS KEEP THEIR OWN SPACE
why: The audit found adjacent crawler names printed together. Later world names now stack above occupied label boxes, including crew blocks and health pips. The extraction distance chip also avoids the cache names drawn in the same frame. Only draw coordinates change. Watch in a crowded fight: names should stay separate at 1080p and 4K, wounded health pips should stay with their names, and the right edge extraction chip should clear cache names. A crowded tag with no room above the screen is omitted for that frame.
now: Nearby world names stack when their boxes would overlap. The extraction distance chip clears cache names.
